mapper.select: select stat_date as statdate, sum(pv) as pv, sum(uv) as uv from tb_page_stat where stat_date >= #{startDate} and stat_date <= #{endDate} group by stat_date order by stat_date asc

with batch as ( select stat_date, create_time from tb_page_stat where stat_date >= #{startDate} and stat_date <= #{endDate} group by stat_date, create_time having count(*) >= #{batchRows} ) select t.stat_date as statdate, sum(case when b.create_time is null then t.pv else greatest(t.pv - 1, 0) end) as pv, max(t.uv) as uv, sum(case when b.create_time is null then 0 else 1 end) as removedrows from tb_page_stat t left join batch b on b.stat_date = t.stat_date and b.create_time = t.create_time where t.stat_date >= #{startDate} and t.stat_date <= #{endDate} group by t.stat_date order by t.stat_date asc
